sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
sources.evidence: March 17, 2026 announcement explicitly releases GPT-5.4 mini in the API, Codex and ChatGPT. The mini availability section states a 400k API context, text/image input, function calling, tool search and computer use. Exact mini benchmark columns report performance, not parameter counts.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Mini API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact model documentation names GPT-5.4 Mini, default snapshot gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, 400,000 total context, 272,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input and text output. It explicitly lists reasoning tokens, none/low/medium/high/xhigh effort, function calling, prompt caching, file uploads, Chat Completions and Responses. No architecture inventory or parameter count is stated.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card, Appendix: GPT-5.4 mini
sources.evidence: The mini appendix was added March 17, 2026. Sections 6.1-6.3 and Tables 16-20 contain exact mini safety, CoT controllability and preparedness evaluations. They disclose no total/active production parameters or detailed architecture; the main full-size model training section is not transferred to mini.

sources.title: Investigating the consequences of accidentally grading CoT during RL
sources.evidence: May 7, 2026 report explicitly names released GPT-5.4 mini and describes unintended CoT grading in less than 1.5% of its samples. This confirms model-specific RL/CoT evidence but gives no numerical production model size or neural architecture.

sources.title: Self-replicating prompt injections exist
sources.evidence: September 25, 2026 research identifies attacker and defender models based on GPT-5.4-mini as internal-only research checkpoints. It reports self-play training behavior without counts or structure; those derived checkpoints are not treated as the released API model.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: The later April 23, 2026 card was checked in full extracted PDF text for exact GPT-5.4 mini references and parameter disclosures. No exact mini column or named-model structural/count disclosure was found; full-size GPT-5.4 comparisons are not mini evidence.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 System Card
sources.evidence: The later July 9, 2026 card was checked in full extracted PDF text for exact GPT-5.4 mini references and count disclosures. No exact mini reference was found. Successor and full-size comparison specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6 and describes prompt caching through Transformer attention key/value projections. Combined with the exact mini caching feature, it supports a qualified broad Transformer-based inference, not a complete block inventory, dense/MoE classification or parameter counts.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses API PDF processing sends extracted text and page images to vision-capable models; Chat Completions also accepts PDF files. Combined with the exact mini vision, file-upload and endpoint support, this supports PDF as an API input format rather than an additional native sensory modality.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: March 17, 2026 explicitly releases gpt-5.4-mini to Chat Completions and Responses and documents tool search, built-in computer use and compaction.

sources.title: Model Release Notes
sources.evidence: The March 18, 2026 entry announces ChatGPT rollout of GPT-5.4 mini through Thinking for Free/Go and as a paid-user fallback. This product rollout note does not override the March 17 API launch.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: Current deprecation notices were searched for the exact GPT-5.4 mini identifier and dated snapshot; no notice was found. Notices for GPT-5 Mini or other GPT variants do not establish a mini shutdown.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant nonexclusive service/API use and reserve ownership of the services. This supports a descriptive proprietary hosted-service classification, not an open-weight license. The page was accessed through the web index after a direct HTTP fetch returned 403.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: The official inventory lists GPT-5.4 Mini as a hosted model, distinct from its Open-weight models section listing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b under Apache 2.0. The checked release and exact-model documentation offer no mini weights.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-5.4 mini record
sources.evidence: Original catalog source was inspected as a lead. Its descriptive and capability assertions were independently checked against primary sources.

name.note: Use the capitalization of the official API display name.

developer.note: OpenAI publishes the model and its original system-card appendix.

family.note: Normalize the named generation; mini remains the exact variant and does not imply shared weights with full-size or nano models.

release_date.note: Explicit original API/Codex launch and mini appendix are March 17. The March 18 ChatGPT rollout entry is a distinct product note. The default dated API snapshot is also March 17.

open_weights.note: Checked primary release/model pages distribute this model through hosted services, not downloadable weights; official open-weight inventory lists separate gpt-oss models.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification with reserved service IP, not an SPDX identifier or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total count is disclosed in original mini material or later exact-model RL research. Later GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 cards were checked without finding an exact mini count. Targeted first-party parameter/training/interpretability searches found no numerical disclosure. Smaller and faster are not numerical counts.

active_parameters_b.note: The same bounded original/later evidence gives no per-token active count or dense/MoE layout. Do not equate active and total counts, infer counts from benchmark percentages, or transfer derivative/successor sizes.

architecture.note: Qualified cross-source inference: exact mini documentation explicitly supports prompt caching and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 technical guide explains Transformer attention KV state. This supports broad Transformer-based classification only. Original/later cards and targeted training/interpretability checks do not establish complete block composition, dense/MoE layout or parameter counts.

context_window.note: Original announcement and current exact-model documentation agree on 400,000 total tokens; the API separately specifies 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. No full-size 1M context is transferred, and compaction does not enlarge a single context window.

modalities.note: Native text/image input and text output. PDF is included as an API document format processed into text and page images. The hosted image-generation tool does not establish native image output.

reasoning.note: Exact model supports reasoning tokens and none (default), low, medium, high and xhigh effort. The mini appendix and later exact-model RL report independently describe its CoT; default none does not negate reasoning capability.

tool_call.note: Exact mini documentation explicitly supports function calling, tool search and computer use; no nano or full-size behavior is assumed.

description.value: OpenAI model for coding and computer use, with configurable reasoning, text and image inputs, and tool calling.

Investigating the consequences of accidentally grading CoT during RL

patch.notes: Released March 17, 2026 in the API and Codex; a March 18 release note describes the ChatGPT rollout. Current default API snapshot is gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17. The 400,000-token context has separate 272,000-token input and 128,000-token output maxima. Reasoning supports none, low, medium, high and xhigh. PDF denotes API extraction into text and page images; image generation uses a hosted tool. Transformer is a qualified inference from exact mini prompt-caching support and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 KV-cache documentation. Detailed topology and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed in checked sources. No exact API deprecation notice was found; current endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Confirm March 17 release, OpenAI attribution, 400K context, reasoning and tool calling. Normalize official display name and GPT-5.4 family; add Proprietary, PDF API input and a qualified broad Transformer classification. Replace promotional description. Counts remain undisclosed after original mini appendix, later exact-model training research and successor-card checks; no exact API deprecation found.
